column1: # A row may carry `frame=<ported class>` as a trailing TAB-separated field — the `unit` the
# correlator anchors the failure at, copied from `run-latest/test-failures.tsv`. Keyed on (suite,
# test) alone a row absorbs a NEW failure with a DIFFERENT cause in the same test, silently, and
# the sentence below would then be about something that is not happening; anchored, the claim stops
# holding the moment the failure moves and the failure counts UNEXPECTED. The column is optional
# for the files that predate it; a new row should carry one.

column3: reason

maintainer decision 2026-08-14: Map.Entry stays Tuple2 (idiomatic pairs) and a class IMPLEMENTING Map.Entry is unsupported — scala's idiom for custom-comparison sorting is an Ordering, not an entry subclass; the counted InexpressibleParent/ReifiedOccurrence refusal on Sort$ComparableMapEntry is the mechanism (ENGINE-LIMITS K18/K5.7)

maintainer decision 2026-09-20: jackson is off this port's compile classpath, and the one jackson operation with no cross-platform meaning is reading an arbitrary object's FIELDS — Inspectable and EAGER evaluate mode. JsonMapper.normalise refuses it by name (UnsupportedOperationException) instead of answering with an empty map; a java.util.Map and a LiquidSupport answering toLiquid() are both still converted
